chosen_edition: The Hymnal of the Reformed Church (1920), no. 107

editorial.method: Human word-for-word comparison against the chosen edition required

notes: Five stanzas, credited 'Anon. (Latin, c. 12th Cent.) Tr. John M. Neale, 1851' (Neale's familiar version, not Lacey's revision). The book prints the 'Rejoice! Rejoice!' refrain within every stanza; it is given once as its own stanza after stanza 1, and the typographically wrapped lines 'come and / cheer' and 'leads on / high' are rejoined; the spelling 'hight' is kept.
